text: 後退Euler離散モードと時間厳密半離散拡散の参照 Backward-Euler discrete modes and time-exact semidiscrete diffusion references 後退Euler離散モードと時間厳密半離散拡散の参照 \lambda_{\ell,h}=4h^{-2}\sin^2(\ell\pi h/2),\quad a_{\ell,k+1}=\frac{a_{\ell,k}+\Delta t\,\theta\beta_\ell}{1+\Delta t\,\kappa\lambda_{\ell,h}};\quad a_{\ell}^{\rm sd}(T)=a_{\ell,0}e^{-\kappa\lambda_{\ell,h}T}+\frac{\theta\beta_\ell}{\kappa\lambda_{\ell,h}}(1-e^{-\kappa\lambda_{\ell,h}T}). 無次元x∈[0,1]、同次Dirichlet、κ=.1、θ=.2、T=.1。内点7/15、時間step64/128/256。目的関数はh重み付き終端誤差と指定二次正則化です。 Backward-Euler discrete modes and time-exact semidiscrete diffusion references \lambda_{\ell,h}=4h^{-2}\sin^2(\ell\pi h/2),\quad a_{\ell,k+1}=\frac{a_{\ell,k}+\Delta t\,\theta\beta_\ell}{1+\Delta t\,\kappa\lambda_{\ell,h}};\quad a_{\ell}^{\rm sd}(T)=a_{\ell,0}e^{-\kappa\lambda_{\ell,h}T}+\frac{\theta\beta_\ell}{\kappa\lambda_{\ell,h}}(1-e^{-\kappa\lambda_{\ell,h}T}). Dimensionless x in [0,1] with zero Dirichlet data, kappa = .1, theta = .2 and T = .1. Use 7/15 interior nodes and 64/128/256 time steps.
